# SMS reminder provider: Sinch

Decided on 2026-10-13 by the Weekly sync attendees.

## Decision
SMS reminder provider is **Sinch**. The migration is scheduled to take effect from 2026-11-01.

## Why
Vonage kept failing on Portuguese numbers during pilot rollout; Sinch was chosen as a replacement to improve delivery rates.

This replaces [[Decision - SMS reminder provider is Vonage]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Priya will redesign the SMS templates for Sinch. Billing and documentation updates are required before 2026-11-01.

# Release cadence: twice-weekly (Tuesdays & Thursdays)

Decided on 2026-10-15 by [[Tom Lindqvist]] and [[Daniel Reyes]].

## Decision
Release cadence is **twice-weekly**, on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Releases remain behind feature flags.

## Why
Continuous deploys were surprising pilot clinics; a predictable cadence reduces disruption while keeping feature flags for control.

This replaces [[Decision - Release cadence is continuous deploys behind feature flags]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Daniel will prepare comms for pilot clinics about the new schedule.

# Investor update cadence: monthly update with a metrics dashboard link

Decided on 2026-10-16 by [[Maya Okafor]].

## Decision
Investor update cadence is **monthly update**. The metrics dashboard link will be retained and included with the monthly update.

## Why
Brightpath asked the team to slow down updates and move back to a monthly cadence; keeping the metrics dashboard preserves transparency between updates.

This replaces [[Decision - Investor update cadence is fortnightly update with a metrics dashboard link]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Maintain access to the metrics dashboard; schedule the monthly email on the first Monday as previously documented where relevant.

# Weekly sync, 2026-10-13

Attendees: [[Maya Okafor]], [[Tom Lindqvist]], [[Priya Raman]], [[Daniel Reyes]], [[Sofia Marchetti]], [[Kenji Watanabe]]

- Launch recap: we launched publicly on 6 October as planned. Early feedback from clinics is good.
- SMS reminders: Vonage keeps failing on Portuguese numbers. Agreed: we move SMS reminders to [[Decision - SMS reminder provider is Sinch]] from 1 November. Vonage is out.
- Kenji to stop the Vonage rollout; that task is no longer needed.
- Action: Priya to redesign the SMS reminder templates for Sinch by 30 October.
- Support tool: Sofia floated moving from Plain to Zendesk. Not decided; Maya wants to see Plain's new pricing first. Revisit in December.
- Several receptionists asked again for per-practitioner colours on the calendar.

## Discussion
Launch feedback is positive; clinics are reporting useful improvements. Delivery failures for Portuguese numbers continued with Vonage which motivated the decision to move providers. No final decision on support tool — defer to December when Plain's new pricing is available.

## Actions
- [[Priya Raman]]: Redesign SMS reminder templates for Sinch (due 2026-10-30).
- Investigate per-practitioner calendar colours (backlog).
